files_changed_self_report.rationale: Removed the unsafe Conftest bare-binary fallback, documented reusable-workflow check-name behavior, made bypass approval effective without masking unrelated denies, and added strict summary validation before artifact upload.

Hardened bypass pairing by requiring the decision row to reference the rule, requiring a newly added matching waiver entry, checking expiry, normalizing waiver paths, and avoiding regex-based rule matching.
Tightened expires_at fields to a concrete ISO date contract for downstream consumers.
Expanded waiver entries to support rule_id or finding_id matching with closed properties and explicit date/date-time validation.
Inlined a waiver-file schema that accepts rule-based and finding-based entries without relying on the previous incompatible item shape.
Updated scope and verification requirements to include the waiver schemas, actionlint, and an explicit waiver-schema acceptance/rejection check; documented the combined check-context behavior.
Aligned the fix-round verification requirements with the added actionlint and waiver-schema checks and documented the combined check-context behavior.

self_reported_concerns: Reusable-workflow check contexts are now documented as combined caller/callee names, but 020E.a still needs to empirically record the exact GitHub-rendered context before 020D2 branch-protection configuration.
codex_structured_result.summary: Patched the 020b reusable policy-check slice to close the break-glass, supply-chain, summary-validation, and dispatch-verification gaps: the workflow no longer accepts an unverified vendored Conftest binary, validated bypasses now take effect only for the approved rule, waiver and summary schemas are enforced with format checking, waiver entries must be newly added and unexpired, and the reusable-workflow check-context behavior is documented in both the workflow and dispatch packages. I also updated the waiver schemas and both 020b dispatch packages to add actionlint and waiver-schema verification, then ran the required verify commands, actionlint, and a synthetic bypass smoke test successfully.
